  SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE billing_country = 'USA'

    AND invoice_date < '2025-01-01'
),
base_period AS (
  SELECT SUM(total) AS revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE billing_country = 'USA'
    AND invoice_date >= '2023-01-01'

SELECT

  base_period.revenue AS base_revenue,
